assertion_results.text: Data extraction identifies the ecosystem as RPM based on the library name (openssl-libs) and component context, not Cargo (Step 1 Ecosystem detection — read ecosystems from Ecosystem Mappings config)
assertion_results.evidence: data-extraction.md line 24: 'Ecosystem: RPM (system package, not a source dependency)'. Line 26: 'openssl-libs is a system-level RPM package, not a source dependency (Cargo/npm). The ecosystem is determined by the package type.' References the Ecosystem Mappings table in security-matrix.md for confirmation.

assertion_results.text: Version impact table includes ALL versions from the 2.2.x stream supportability matrix (2.2.0 through 2.2.4) and uses rpms.lock.yaml data for version extraction (Step 2.3)
assertion_results.evidence: version-impact.md lines 9-13 contain a table with all five versions: 2.2.0, 2.2.1, 2.2.2, 2.2.3, 2.2.4. Line 8 states 'Data source: rpms.lock.yaml at each pinned tag in the 2.2.x supportability matrix.' Each row includes the openssl-libs version extracted from rpms.lock.yaml.

assertion_results.text: Dependency chain context identifies openssl-libs as present in rpms.lock.yaml and uses this to determine the package origin — the lock file presence is the primary classification signal (Step 2.3.5)
assertion_results.evidence: version-impact.md lines 27-28: 'rpms.lock.yaml: present -> explicit install'. Line 35: 'openssl-libs is classified as an explicit install because it is present in rpms.lock.yaml. It is not inherited solely from the base image -- it is explicitly pinned in the RPM lock file.' Lock file presence is used as the primary classification signal.

assertion_results.text: Remediation creates a single task for the Konflux release repo — not the two-task upstream backport + downstream propagation flow used for source dependency ecosystems (Step 8 Remediation Task Creation — system package path)
assertion_results.evidence: remediation.md line 5: 'A single remediation task is created because openssl-libs is an RPM system package ecosystem (not a source dependency). RPM packages do not require an upstream backport task -- the fix happens directly in the Konflux release repo.' Only one task is created targeting rhtpa-release.0.4.z. Lines 93-96 explicitly contrast with two-task source dependency flow.

assertion_results.text: Remediation task description follows task-description-template.md format with Repository, Target Branch, Description, Implementation Notes, and Acceptance Criteria sections — Files to Modify is intentionally omitted per remediation-templates.md (Step 8 Remediation Task Creation)
assertion_results.evidence: remediation.md task description contains all required sections: Repository (line 28: rhtpa-release.0.4.z), Target Branch (line 32: main), Description (line 36), Implementation Notes (line 57), Acceptance Criteria (line 65). Files to Modify is absent from the template. Line 77 explicitly states: 'Files to Modify section is intentionally omitted per remediation-templates.md.'

assertion_results.text: The version impact output addresses SBOM verification in the dependency chain context — either noting that verification was skipped because cosign is not available or because external tools are prohibited, or presenting the SBOM classification result (Step 2.3.5 Optional SBOM verification)
